checkedSources.finding: Current Drexel job board shows two College of Computing and Informatics/Engineering jobs: Postdoctoral Research Fellow and Research Associate II.

Research Associate II in ECE Wireless Systems Lab explicitly accepts an MS in EE, computer engineering, computer science, or related field; research covers wireless systems, networks, embedded systems, AI-enabled wireless, and CS collaborations; rolling review.
Current Postdoctoral Research Fellow is in immunology, biomaterials, and chemical engineering; CS not among required PhD fields, so excluded.

findings: Added current ECE Research Associate II as an adjacent CS-eligible research position. The other computing-college-adjacent postdoc is life-sciences experimental work with no CS degree eligibility.
recordUpdates: Added ECE wireless research associate (job 507203); excluded unrelated immunology postdoc.
